text: Nice and clean. But has problem on screens with bottom system navigation bar enabled. The app bottom nav bar will be covered by the system nav bar. Will you please fix it?
author: Charles Kim
developer_reply: Thank you for pointing this out, I appreciate you taking the time to report it. Could you please send an email to dev@edvarderos.com with a screenshot of the issue? That will make it much easier for me to see what’s happening on your device and fix it properly. Thanks again for your feedback!
